Liviu Stefan Calo fi r Date of birth: 29/09/1991 Nationality: Romanian, Italian Gender: Male Phone number: (+32) 0478790298 (Work) Email address: lcalo fi r@yahoo.it LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/liviustefancalo fi r/ Skype: l.calo fi r Address: Rue de la Ferme, 92, 1210, Brussels, Belgium (Home) Experienced consultant with 7+ years’ experience in EU policy consulting, project coordination and business development. Skilled in managing complex projects for DG REFORM, DG ENER, DG MOVE, DG RTD and CINEA. Strong track record in leading multicultural teams, proposal design, and stakeholder engagement. Passionate about European policies, with a proven ability to deliver results under pressure. MANAGER – ERNST AND YOUNG (EY) BELGIUM – 01/11/2023 – Current – BRUSSELS, BELGIUM • Managing EU-funded projects and framework contracts for SG REFORM, DG ENER, DG RTD and CINEA, focusing on structural reforms, energy transition and public sector modernisation. • Providing strategic direction, technical oversight and quality assurance to ensure timely and high-quality delivery. • Supervising multidisciplinary teams and coordinating international experts, consortium partners and EU o ffi cials. • Leading business development e ff orts, including proposal design and tender management under TSI, ENER, and CINEA framework contracts. • Coaching and mentoring junior consultants, fostering collaboration and professional growth within the team. • Representing EY Belgium before clients and institutional partners, strengthening the fi rm’s positioning in the EU consultancy market. • Facilitating internal and external training and knowledge-sharing activities. SENIOR CONSULTANT – VALDANI VICARI & ASSOCIATI (VVA BRUSSELS) – 14/10/2019 – 31/10/2023 – BRUSSELS, BELGIUM • Managed and supported the implementation of EU-funded studies and technical assistance projects for DG REFORM, DG ENER, DG EMPL and DG MARE. • Acted as project coordinator, liaising with clients, consortium partners and international experts on complex assignments. • Designed and implemented large-scale research and stakeholder consultation activities (desk research, case studies, surveys, workshops, focus groups). • Drafted methodological sections, evaluation frameworks, and fi nal reports in line with EU Better Regulation Guidelines. • Supported proposal preparation and tender coordination under multiple framework contracts. • Represented VVA Brussels before clients and partners, building trust-based professional relationships CUSTOMER RELATIONS MANAGER – ACCENTURE SERVICES – 09/12/2018 – 01/10/2019 – BUCHAREST, ROMANIA • Managing projects, in cooperation with the Technical Account Manager and more than twenty large international clients and SMEs, to carry out technical assignments and fi nancial resports related to Microsoft tools and platforms; • Overseeing end-to-end support process and managing bottlenecks' support to ensure smooth progression and stakeholder engagement; • Identifying business development opportunities for process fastening, reducing the incidence tackling duration, and technical assistance to business operations improvement. PROJECT OFFICER – LATTANZIO KIBS – 03/09/2018 – 30/11/2018 – BUCHAREST, ROMANIA ABOUT ME WORK EXPERIENCE

• Providing support to tendering process by assisting and preparing Expressions of Interest (EOI), pre-quali fi cation documents and drafting sections of technical proposals; • Leading tender monitoring activities, by consulting on a daily basis several public procurement tools and databases (such as Development Aid, Assortis and TED.eu); • Identifying, assessing and interacting with thematic key experts in the context of projects and proposals related to the Europe Aid SIEA FWC. EU COMMISSION BLUEBOOK STAGEUR – EUROPEAN AGENCY FOR SMALL AND MEDIUM-SIZED ENTERPRISES (EASME) – 28/02/2018 – 30/07/2018 – BRUXELLES, BELGIUM • Supporting users' requests for audits, internal and expost control teams in the Finance and Administration Department; • Data analysis pertaining to the the COSME programme and energy-intensive industries projects funded by EASME, on behalf of the Finance and Administration Department; • Facilitating the cross-organisational work fl ows of the Sta ff Engagement and Business Transformation Unit. Plac Europejski 6, 00-844 Warsaw, Poland | Tel. +48 22 205 95 00 | www.frontex.europa.eu | Email: frontex@frontex.europa.eu For your personal data protection information please refer to: https://frontex.europa.eu/careers/how-to-apply/data-protection/ FRONTEX APPLICATION FORM - RCT-2026-00015 MY PERSONAL DATA 1. First ( given ) name* 2. Surname ( family name )* 3. Gender* 4. Date of birth* 5. Address (street / number / post office code / city / country)* 6. Telephone number ( including int’l prefix )* 7. E-mail address ( to be used for communication )* Make sure that this e-mail address is correctly entered and frequently monitored by you as it will be used by Frontex to communicate with you regarding your application. This application form is specifically created specifically for this selection procedure. It shall be: 1. Downloaded and opened in a PDF reader in a MS Windows equipped computer – the recommended version is the Adobe Acrobat Reader DC (version 2022.001.20169. You may download this free version here: https://get.adobe.com/uk/reader/). Opening the file and working only in a browser or in MacOS is not supported and such an application might be refused by the automated processing system. 2. The form is digitally signed and protected against any manipulation or changes . Therefore, applicants shall not try to manipulate and/or alter it – in such a case the digital signature will disappear, and the application form will become invalid for subsequent processing resulting in an automatic rejection of such a submission. 3. Filled in electronically in English language. Avoid using specific characters of a national (non-English) alphabet. 4. Fields, where you may enter your input, are highlighted in light blue colour . Fields marked with an asterisk (*) indicate a required input. 5. When entering dates, the only accepted format is DD/MM/YYYY (if you use different format, e.g. DD-MM-YYYY or DD.MM.YYYY, the automatic calculation fields may not display the calculations correctly). 6. You should be concise – the space for your input is limited by the size of the text boxes . 7. In case you have technical issues with filling/saving this form, you may write to us at AD6TalentPool@frontex.europa.eu .
